source_description_html:
The Stylmartin Vertigo WP blends motorcycle protection with outdoor-inspired design. Built on a hiking-boot platform, the Vertigo delivers everyday comfort while integrating key motorcycle safety features for riding and exploring beyond the bike.

D3O® technology and reinforcements in the sole, heel, and toe areas provide impact protection where it matters most, while the full-grain leather construction ensures durability and long-term comfort. The Vertigo transitions easily from two wheels to walking, making it a versatile option for riders who value function and mobility.

Its sleek, understated design works equally well in urban environments and outdoor settings, offering protection without sacrificing style.

Comes in black or brown.

UPPER: Upper and cuff in full grain leather
LINING: waterproof and breathable
MALLEOLUS PROTECTIONS: D3O internal protection on both sides

PROTECTIONS: leather gear protection
FASTENING: laces
REFLEX INSERTS: on upper, loop, malleolus and laces
FOOTBED: changeable and anatomic
SOLE: “Traction” antislip rubber sole
